sentences.text: 7. Accordingly, petitioner's counsel states that under Section 319 Cr.P.C., summoning cannot happen merely on a statement made by the complainant; since the investigation is complete, charge sheet has been filed and the charges have not been framed.
Counsel for petitioner also highlights that even at the stage of cognizance, the petitioner was not summoned.

8. APP for State, however, points out that further proceedings in the matter had been stayed by order of this Court during the pendency of the matter; also points out to another judgment of the Supreme Court in Rajesh& Ors. v. State of Haryana, AIR 2019 SC 2168 which states that 'evidence'
